# Create a TRIPID
```{python}
# Function to read CSV with encoding handling
def read_csv_with_encoding(file_path):
    try:
        return pd.read_csv(file_path, encoding="utf-8")  # Try UTF-8 first
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return pd.read_csv(file_path, encoding="ISO-8859-1")  # Fallback to ISO-8859-1
      
# Define the folder path
folder_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data\us_nhts"
trippub = read_csv_with_encoding(os.path.join(folder_path, "trippub.csv"))


# Clean & coerce key fields
for col in ["HOUSEID", "PERSONID", "TDTRPNUM"]:
    trippub[col] = pd.to_numeric(trippub[col], errors="coerce")

# Optional: verify there are no duplicate trip keys
dups = trippub.duplicated(["HOUSEID", "PERSONID", "TDTRPNUM"]).sum()
if dups:
    print(f"Warning: {dups} duplicate trip keys found.")

# Create TRIPID as a readable, unique string
trippub["TRIPID"] = (
    trippub["HOUSEID"].astype("Int64").astype(str).str.strip() + "-" +
    trippub["PERSONID"].astype("Int64").astype(str).str.zfill(3) + "-" +
    trippub["TDTRPNUM"].astype("Int64").astype(str).str.zfill(2)
)

# If you prefer an integer hash (compact, joinable), also make this:
trippub["TRIPHASH"] = (
    trippub["HOUSEID"].astype("Int64").astype(str) + "_" +
    trippub["PERSONID"].astype("Int64").astype(str) + "_" +
    trippub["TDTRPNUM"].astype("Int64").astype(str)
).apply(hash).astype("int64")


key = ["HOUSEID","PERSONID","TDTRPNUM","TDAYDATE"]
dups = trippub.duplicated(key).sum()
trippub["TRIPID"] = (
    trippub["HOUSEID"].astype("Int64").astype(str) + "-" +
    trippub["PERSONID"].astype("Int64").astype(str).str.zfill(3) + "-" +
    trippub["TDAYDATE"].astype(str) + "-" +
    trippub["TDTRPNUM"].astype("Int64").astype(str).str.zfill(2)
)


output_file = os.path.join(folder_path, "trippub_id.csv")
trippub.to_csv(output_file, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
```

# Construct a Tour (closed)
    """
    Assign TOURID per (HOUSEID, PERSONID, TDAYDATE[, TRAVDAY]):
    - Create TRIPID_n = 1,2,3,... as the within-group order of trips
      (sorted by STRTTIME, then TRIPID for ties).
    - If WHYFROM == 1 AND WHYTO == 1, set TOURID = TRIPID_n.
    - Else, TOURID = <NA>.
    """
```{python}
import os 
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# ---------- Read ----------
def read_csv_with_encoding(file_path):
    try:
        return pd.read_csv(file_path, encoding="utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return pd.read_csv(file_path, encoding="ISO-8859-1")

folder_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data\us_nhts"
trippubid = read_csv_with_encoding(os.path.join(folder_path, "trippub_id.csv"))


# ---------- Checks ----------
required = ["HOUSEID","PERSONID","TRIPID","TDAYDATE","WHYFROM","WHYTO"]
missing = [c for c in required if c not in trippubid.columns]
if missing:
    raise KeyError(f"Required column(s) missing: {missing}")

# ---------- Normalize types (no function; top-level only) ----------
df = trippubid.copy()

df["HOUSEID"]  = pd.to_numeric(df["HOUSEID"],  errors="coerce").astype("Int64").astype(str).str.strip()
df["PERSONID"] = pd.to_numeric(df["PERSONID"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64").astype(str).str.strip()
df["TDAYDATE"] = pd.to_numeric(df["TDAYDATE"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

if "TRAVDAY" not in df.columns:
    df["TRAVDAY"] = pd.NA
df["TRAVDAY"] = df["TRAVDAY"].astype("string")

df["WHYFROM"] = pd.to_numeric(df["WHYFROM"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
df["WHYTO"]   = pd.to_numeric(df["WHYTO"],   errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

# IMPORTANT: TRIPID is a string key
df["TRIPID"] = df["TRIPID"].astype("string")

# --- assumes you already have df built and sorted, and group_cols set ---
# sort (idempotent if you already sorted)
sort_cols = ["HOUSEID","PERSONID","TDAYDATE","TRAVDAY"]
if "STRTTIME" in df.columns:
    sort_cols += ["STRTTIME"]
elif "TDTRPNUM" in df.columns:
    sort_cols += ["TDTRPNUM"]
else:
    sort_cols += ["TRIPID"]
df = df.sort_values(sort_cols, kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)

group_cols = ["HOUSEID","PERSONID","TDAYDATE","TRAVDAY"]
df["TRIPID_n"] = (df.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False).cumcount() + 1).astype("Int64")

# Robust boolean flags (nullable Int64 -> treat NA as False)
df["start_is_home"] = (df["WHYFROM"] == 1).fillna(False).astype(int)
df["end_is_home"]   = (df["WHYTO"]   == 1).fillna(False).astype(int)

group_cols = ["HOUSEID","PERSONID","TDAYDATE","TRAVDAY"]

# Cumulative counts within each person-day
df["starts_cum"] = df.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False)["start_is_home"].cumsum()
ends_cum         = df.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False)["end_is_home"].cumsum()

# Count of home-arrivals BEFORE the current row (avoid group-wise shift by subtracting current flag)
df["ends_prev"]  = ends_cum - df["end_is_home"]

# Inside a tour from a home-departure until (and including) the next home-arrival
in_tour = (df["starts_cum"] - df["ends_prev"]) >= 1

# TOUR_NUM = start count for rows inside a tour; NA otherwise
df["TOUR_NUM"] = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="Float64")
df.loc[in_tour, "TOUR_NUM"] = df.loc[in_tour, "starts_cum"].astype("Int64").astype(float)

# Build TOURID
df["TOURID"] = pd.NA
has_tour = df["TOUR_NUM"].notna()
tour_num_str = df.loc[has_tour, "TOUR_NUM"].astype(int).astype(str).str.zfill(2)
df.loc[has_tour, "TOURID"] = (
    df.loc[has_tour, "HOUSEID"].astype(str).str.strip() + "-"
    + df.loc[has_tour, "PERSONID"].astype(str).str.strip() + "-"
    + df.loc[has_tour, "TDAYDATE"].astype("Int64").astype(str) + "-"
    + df.loc[has_tour, "TRAVDAY"].fillna("NA").astype(str) + "-N" + tour_num_str
).astype("string")

# Force trips where WHYFROM==1 and WHYTO==1 on the same row to NA
mask_same_home = df["WHYFROM"].eq(1) & df["WHYTO"].eq(1)
df.loc[mask_same_home, ["TOUR_NUM","TOURID"]] = pd.NA

# Renumber tours consecutively within each person-day (skip NA rows)
def _renumber_tours(g: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    vals = g["TOUR_NUM"]
    # preserve order of first occurrence within the group
    uniq_in_order = pd.unique(vals.dropna())
    mapping = {v: i + 1 for i, v in enumerate(uniq_in_order)}
    out = vals.map(mapping)
    return out.astype("Float64")  # keep NA capability

group_cols = ["HOUSEID","PERSONID","TDAYDATE","TRAVDAY"]
df["TOUR_NUM"] = (
    df.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False, group_keys=False)
      .apply(_renumber_tours)
)

# Rebuild TOURID from the renumbered TOUR_NUM
df["TOURID"] = pd.NA
has_tour = df["TOUR_NUM"].notna()
tour_num_str = df.loc[has_tour, "TOUR_NUM"].astype(int).astype(str).str.zfill(2)

df.loc[has_tour, "TOURID"] = (
    df.loc[has_tour, "HOUSEID"].astype(str).str.strip() + "-"
    + df.loc[has_tour, "PERSONID"].astype(str).str.strip() + "-"
    + df.loc[has_tour, "TDAYDATE"].astype("Int64").astype(str) + "-"
    + df.loc[has_tour, "TRAVDAY"].fillna("NA").astype(str) + "-N" + tour_num_str
).astype("string")

# (optional) clean up helpers
# df = df.drop(columns=["start_is_home","end_is_home","starts_cum","ends_prev"])
print(df.loc[(df["HOUSEID"]=="30000012") & (df["PERSONID"]=="1") & (df["TRAVDAY"]=="5"),
             ["TDTRPNUM","STRTTIME","ENDTIME","WHYFROM","WHYTO","TRIPID_n","TOUR_NUM","TOURID"]])

# Save
output_file = os.path.join(folder_path, "trippub_id_tour.csv")
df.to_csv(output_file, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
```
```{python}
dT = df.copy()  # if you want the result in dT; or keep using df
dT = dT[dT["TOURID"].notna()].copy()

# Rebuild these two if you dropped them earlier
dT["start_is_home"] = (dT["WHYFROM"] == 1).fillna(False).astype(int)
dT["end_is_home"]   = (dT["WHYTO"]   == 1).fillna(False).astype(int)

group_cols = ["HOUSEID","PERSONID","TDAYDATE","TRAVDAY"]

# Cumulative home-starts / home-ends (again; safe to recompute)
starts_cum = dT.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False)["start_is_home"].cumsum()
ends_cum   = dT.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False)["end_is_home"].cumsum()

# Your TOUR_NUM is the (renumbered) start count inside the person-day.
# If you renamed, adapt here; we’ll use it directly:
tour_num = dT["TOUR_NUM"]

# Mark first/last trips *by event*, not by position after sorting
dT["first_in_tour"] = (dT["start_is_home"].eq(1) & starts_cum.eq(tour_num)).astype(int)
dT["last_in_tour"]  = (dT["end_is_home"].eq(1)   & ends_cum.eq(tour_num)).astype(int)

# Sanity checks should now pass (or at least be far fewer)
check_first = dT.loc[dT["first_in_tour"].eq(1), "WHYFROM"].eq(1).all()
check_last  = dT.loc[dT["last_in_tour"].eq(1),  "WHYTO"].eq(1).all()
print("First departs home:", check_first, "| Last arrives home:", check_last)

print("Bad first tours:",
      dT.loc[dT["first_in_tour"].eq(1) & ~dT["WHYFROM"].eq(1), "TOURID"].nunique())
print("Bad last tours:",
      dT.loc[dT["last_in_tour"].eq(1)  & ~dT["WHYTO"].eq(1),  "TOURID"].nunique())
```

# Drop unrecorded values
```{python}
#Load dataset
df_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "hh_per_tour.csv")
df_2 = pd.read_csv(df_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

# drop duplicated columns
df_2 = df_2.loc[:, ~df_2.columns.duplicated()]


# TDTRPNUM (tour complexity) / CNTTDHH (Count of HH trips) / CNTTDTR	(Count of person trips) 
# STRTTIME (Start Time) / ENDTIME	(End Time) / WHYTRP1S (Purpose)
# R_SEX_IMP (gender) / R_AGE_IMP (age)
# HHSIZE (Count of HH members) / YOUNGCHILD (Count of age 0-4 in HH) / NUMADLT (Count of adults in HH)

# Work status
df_2 = df_2[~df_2["WORKER"].isin([-1, -9])]

# Single or 2+ adults
df_2 = df_2[~df_2["LIF_CYC"].isin([-9])]

# Household relationship
df_2 = df_2[~df_2["R_RELAT"].isin([-7, -8, -9])]

# Income
df_2 = df_2[~df_2["HHFAMINC"].isin([-7, -8, -9])]

# Mode
df_2 = df_2[~df_2["TRPTRANS"].isin([-7, -8, -9])]

# Trip purpose
df_2 = df_2[~df_2["TRIPPURP"].isin([-9])]

# Travel distance (keep only nonnegative)
df_2 = df_2[df_2["TRPMILES"] >= 0]

# Travel time (keep only nonnegative)
df_2 = df_2[df_2["DWELTIME"] >= 0]

# Trip Duration
df_2 = df_2[df_2["TRVLCMIN"] >= 0]

# Accompanied
df_2 = df_2[~df_2["HH_ONTD"].isin([-9])] # Number of household members on trip - self reported
df_2 = df_2[~df_2["TRPHHACC"].isin([-9])] # Count of Household Members on Trip - calculated/ constructed variable


output_filtered_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "us_merged_filtered.csv")
df_2.to_csv(output_filtered_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
```

# Household with Children
```{python}
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

folder_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data\us_nhts"
df_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "us_merged_filtered.csv")
df_2 = pd.read_csv(df_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

# Make sure YOUNGCHILD and LIF_CYC are numeric
df_2["YOUNGCHILD"] = pd.to_numeric(df_2["YOUNGCHILD"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
df_2["LIF_CYC"] = pd.to_numeric(df_2["LIF_CYC"], errors="coerce")

# households with children under 10 (from ages)
households_with_u10 = (
    df_2.loc[(df_2["R_AGE"] < 10) & (df_2["R_AGE"] > 0), "HOUSEID"]
      .unique()
)

# households with YOUNGCHILD > 0
households_with_youngchild = df_2.loc[df_2["YOUNGCHILD"] > 0, "HOUSEID"].unique()

# households with LIF_CYC in {3,4,5,6}
households_with_lifcyc = df_2.loc[df_2["LIF_CYC"].isin([3,4,5,6]), "HOUSEID"].unique()

# households with HHSIZE-NUMADLT
households_with_numadlt = df_2.loc[(df_2["HHSIZE"]-df_2["NUMADLT"] > 0), "HOUSEID"].unique()

# union of all three sets
kid_households = set(households_with_u10) | set(households_with_youngchild) | set(households_with_lifcyc) | set(households_with_numadlt)

# subset the dataset
df_kid_hh = df_2[df_2["HOUSEID"].isin(kid_households)]

print("Unique households with children (any definition):", len(kid_households))
print(df_kid_hh.head())

output_filtered_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "us_HHwithU10.csv")
df_kid_hh.to_csv(output_filtered_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
```

# Respondant's age distribution
```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Step 1: Group by RespAgeSimple and SessionId, count unique JourneyIds
journey_counts = (
  df_kid_hh.groupby(["R_AGE_IMP", "PERSONID"])["TOURID"]
  .nunique()
  .reset_index(name="NumJourneys")
)

# Step 2: Sum journeys per age group (across all sessions)
age_journey_summary = journey_counts.groupby("R_AGE_IMP")["NumJourneys"].sum().reset_index()

# Step 3: Ensure RespAgeSimple is a categorical variable with correct order
sorted_ages = sorted(age_journey_summary["R_AGE_IMP"].dropna().unique())
age_journey_summary["R_AGE_IMP"] = pd.Categorical(age_journey_summary["R_AGE_IMP"], 
                                                      categories=sorted_ages,
                                                      ordered=True)

# Step 4: Define tick labels (every 2 years)
custom_ticks = list(range(0,100,2))

# Step 5: Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
sns.barplot(data=age_journey_summary, x="R_AGE_IMP", y="NumJourneys", color="#4C72B0")

# Set custom ticks — match ticks to x-axis labels
plt.xticks(
    ticks=[i for i, age in enumerate(sorted_ages) if age in custom_ticks],
    labels=[age for age in sorted_ages if age in custom_ticks],
    rotation=0
)

# Labels and title
plt.title("Number of Journeys by Respondent Age (0–100)", fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel("Respondent Age", fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel("Count", fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(pad=2)
plt.subplots_adjust(left=0.12)
plt.show()
```

# The number of younger (0-9) /older (10-17) sibling in HH
```{python}
df_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "us_HHwithU10.csv")
df_2 = pd.read_csv(df_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

# ---- Safety: ensure required columns exist ----
required_cols = {"HOUSEID", "R_AGE_IMP", "YOUNGCHILD"}  # YOUNGCHILD is required here
missing = required_cols - set(df_2.columns)
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing required columns: {missing}")

# Clean types
df = df_2.copy()
df["R_AGE_IMP"]  = pd.to_numeric(df["R_AGE_IMP"], errors="coerce")
df["YOUNGCHILD"] = pd.to_numeric(df["YOUNGCHILD"], errors="coerce")
df = df.dropna(subset=["HOUSEID"])  # keep households even if age missing on some rows

# ---- Person-level flags (only ranges the roster actually contains) ----
is_6_9   = df["R_AGE_IMP"].between(6, 9, inclusive="both").fillna(False)
is_10_17 = df["R_AGE_IMP"].between(10, 17, inclusive="both").fillna(False)

# ---- Count people by household ----
by_hh = (
    df.assign(is_6_9=is_6_9.astype(int), is_10_17=is_10_17.astype(int))
      .groupby("HOUSEID", as_index=False)
      .agg(num_6_9=("is_6_9", "sum"),
           num_10_17=("is_10_17", "sum"))
)

# ---- Attach one YOUNGCHILD value per household (count of ages 0–5) ----
yc = (df[["HOUSEID", "YOUNGCHILD"]]
        .dropna(subset=["YOUNGCHILD"])
        .drop_duplicates("HOUSEID"))
# If a household has all YOUNGCHILD missing, treat as 0
by_hh = by_hh.merge(yc, on="HOUSEID", how="left")
by_hh["YOUNGCHILD"] = by_hh["YOUNGCHILD"].fillna(0).astype(int)

# ---- Final household counts ----
# Under 10 (0–9) = 0–5 (from YOUNGCHILD) + 6–9 (from roster)
by_hh["numu10inhh"]   = by_hh["YOUNGCHILD"] + by_hh["num_6_9"]
by_hh["num1017inhh"]  = by_hh["num_10_17"]

# (Optional) keep a tidy subset
hh = by_hh[["HOUSEID", "numu10inhh", "num1017inhh"]].copy()

# ---- Distributions (share of households by count) ----
def dist_table(series, total):
    counts = series.value_counts().sort_index()
    pct = (counts / total * 100).round(2)
    out = pd.DataFrame({"count": counts, "percent_of_households": pct})
    out.index.name = series.name
    return out

total_households = hh.shape[0]
dist_numu10   = dist_table(hh["numu10inhh"],  total_households)
dist_num1017  = dist_table(hh["num1017inhh"], total_households)

print(f"Total households: {total_households:,}\n")
print("Distribution of numu10inhh (0–5 via YOUNGCHILD + 6–9 via roster):")
print(dist_numu10, "\n")
print("Distribution of num1017inhh (10–17 via roster):")
print(dist_num1017)
```

# Costruct "PartyNumu10" and "PartyNum1017" ( resp >= 23)
```{python}
#Load dataset
df_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "us_HHwithU10_1017.csv")
df_2 = pd.read_csv(df_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

df_2.columns = df_2.columns.str.strip()
df_1.columns = df_1.columns.str.strip()

# 0) Keep respondents age 23–69
df_2 = df_2[(pd.to_numeric(df_2["R_AGE_IMP"], errors="coerce") >= 23) &
            (pd.to_numeric(df_2["R_AGE_IMP"], errors="coerce") <= 69)]

# 1) Identify ONTD columns and coerce to nullable ints
ontd_cols = [c for c in df_2.columns if c.upper().startswith("ONTD_P")]
if not ontd_cols:
    raise KeyError("No ONTD_P* columns found in df_2.")

   # Coerce them to numeric (works for both 0/1 flags and ID values)
for c in ontd_cols:
    df_2[c] = pd.to_numeric(df_2[c], errors="coerce")
    
# 2) Person-level lookup: (HOUSEID, PERSONID) -> companion age
age_lookup = (
    df_1[["HOUSEID", "PERSONID", "R_AGE_IMP"]]
      .drop_duplicates()
      .rename(columns={"PERSONID": "COMP_ID", "R_AGE_IMP": "ACC_AGE"})
)

# 3) Melt trips to long; ensure the var name is ONTD_COL
m = df_2[["TRIPID", "HOUSEID"] + ontd_cols].melt(
    id_vars=["TRIPID", "HOUSEID"],
    value_vars=ontd_cols,
    var_name="ONTD_COL",
    value_name="VAL"
)

# 4) Detect schema (flags vs IDs) and build `long`
val_non_na = m["VAL"].dropna()
is_flag_schema = val_non_na.isin([0, 1]).all()

if is_flag_schema:
    # Flag schema: keep rows where flag == 1
    long = m.loc[m["VAL"] == 1].copy()
    # Parse COMP_ID from ONTD_P* suffix (ONTD_P7 -> 7)
    long["COMP_ID"] = long["ONTD_COL"].str.extract(r"ONTD_P(\d+)", expand=False).astype("Int64")
else:
    # ID schema: keep rows with non-null person IDs
    long = m.dropna(subset=["VAL"]).copy()
    long["COMP_ID"] = long["VAL"].astype("Int64")
    
   # Sanity checks so we don't get KeyError surprises again
assert "ONTD_COL" in long.columns or not is_flag_schema, "Expected ONTD_COL in flag schema."
assert "COMP_ID" in long.columns, "COMP_ID not created."

# 5) Attach companion ages; ACC_AGE lives only in the long table
long = (
    long.merge(age_lookup, on=["HOUSEID", "COMP_ID"], how="left")
        [["TRIPID", "HOUSEID", "COMP_ID", "ACC_AGE"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
)

# 6) Per-trip counts from ACC_AGE (companions)
long["ACC_AGE"] = pd.to_numeric(long["ACC_AGE"], errors="coerce")

long["is_6_9"]   = long["ACC_AGE"].between(6, 9, inclusive="both")
long["is_1017"]  = long["ACC_AGE"].between(10, 17, inclusive="both")

counts_age = (
    long.groupby("TRIPID", as_index=True)
        .agg(num_6_9=("is_6_9", "sum"),
             PartyNum1017=("is_1017", "sum"))
        .astype("Int64")
)

# --- 6a) One YOUNGCHILD value per HOUSEID (0–5 count) ---

# Prefer df_1 if it has YOUNGCHILD; else fall back to df_2
if "YOUNGCHILD" in df_1.columns:
    yc_src = df_1[["HOUSEID", "YOUNGCHILD"]].dropna(subset=["YOUNGCHILD"])
elif "YOUNGCHILD" in df_2.columns:
    yc_src = df_2[["HOUSEID", "YOUNGCHILD"]].dropna(subset=["YOUNGCHILD"])
else:
    raise KeyError("YOUNGCHILD not found in df_1 or df_2; needed for 0–5 counts.")

yc = (
    yc_src
    .drop_duplicates("HOUSEID")
    .assign(YOUNGCHILD=pd.to_numeric(yc_src["YOUNGCHILD"], errors="coerce"))
    .fillna({"YOUNGCHILD": 0})
)

# Map HOUSEID → YOUNGCHILD onto trips (via df_2 which has TRIPID, HOUSEID)
trips_yc = (
    df_2[["TRIPID", "HOUSEID"]]
      .drop_duplicates()
      .merge(yc, on="HOUSEID", how="left")
      .fillna({"YOUNGCHILD": 0})
)
trips_yc["YOUNGCHILD"] = trips_yc["YOUNGCHILD"].astype("Int64")

# --- 6b) Combine to get PartyNumu10 per trip ---
counts = (
    counts_age
    .merge(trips_yc[["TRIPID", "YOUNGCHILD"]].set_index("TRIPID"),
           left_index=True, right_index=True, how="left")
    .fillna({"YOUNGCHILD": 0})
)
counts["YOUNGCHILD"] = counts["YOUNGCHILD"].astype("Int64")
counts["PartyNumu10"] = (counts["num_6_9"] + counts["YOUNGCHILD"]).astype("Int64")

counts = counts[["PartyNumu10", "PartyNum1017"]]

# 6c) Build per-trip ACC_AGE columns for df_2 (version-safe)
# (A) list of all companion ages per TRIPID
acc_all = (
    long.dropna(subset=["ACC_AGE"])
        .astype({"ACC_AGE": "Int64"})
        .groupby("TRIPID", as_index=True)["ACC_AGE"]
        .apply(lambda s: sorted(s.tolist()))
        .rename("ACC_AGE_all")
)

# (B) list of minor companion ages (<=17) per TRIPID  [NO 'na=' here]
acc_minors = (
    long.loc[ long["ACC_AGE"].le(17).fillna(False) ]
        .astype({"ACC_AGE": "Int64"})
        .groupby("TRIPID", as_index=True)["ACC_AGE"]
        .apply(lambda s: sorted(s.tolist()))
        .rename("ACC_AGE_minors")
)

# Merge these into df_2 (respondent table). If the series are empty, merge still creates the columns.
df_2 = (
    df_2
    .merge(acc_all.to_frame(), on="TRIPID", how="left")
    .merge(acc_minors.to_frame(), on="TRIPID", how="left")
    .merge(counts, on="TRIPID", how="left")
)

# Replace NaNs with empty lists so the columns are always list-typed
df_2["ACC_AGE_all"]    = df_2["ACC_AGE_all"].apply(lambda x: x if isinstance(x, list) else [])
df_2["ACC_AGE_minors"] = df_2["ACC_AGE_minors"].apply(lambda x: x if isinstance(x, list) else [])
df_2[["PartyNumu10", "PartyNum1017"]] = (
    df_2[["PartyNumu10", "PartyNum1017"]].fillna(0).astype("Int64")
)

# If you want a single minors-only column alias:
df_2["ACC_AGE"] = df_2["ACC_AGE_minors"]

print(df_2["ACC_AGE_all"].map(len).describe(), "  # counts of companions per trip")
print(df_2["ACC_AGE_minors"].map(len).describe(), "# counts of minor companions per trip")
                        

acc_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "us_merged_filtered_acc.csv")
df_2.to_csv(acc_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
long.to_csv(os.path.join(folder_path, "companions_long_with_ACC_AGE.csv"), index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
```

```{python}
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

folder_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data\us_nhts"
dT_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "us_merged_filtered_acc.csv")
dT = pd.read_csv(dT_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

dT.columns = dT.columns.str.strip()

def classify_journey(df):
    df = df.copy()
    required = ["TOURID", "PartyNumu10", "PartyNum1017", "R_AGE_IMP"]
    missing = [c for c in required if c not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        raise KeyError(f"Missing columns: {missing}")
    df[["PartyNumu10","PartyNum1017"]] = df[["PartyNumu10","PartyNum1017"]].fillna(0)
    df["TripHasChild"] = (df["PartyNumu10"] > 0)
    by_tour = (
        df.groupby("TOURID", dropna=False)["TripHasChild"]
          .agg(all_has_child="all", any_has_child="any")
          .reset_index()
    )
    by_tour["JourneyWithChildren"] = np.select(
        [by_tour["all_has_child"], by_tour["any_has_child"]],
        [1, 2],
        default=3
    )
    df = df.drop(columns=["JourneyWithChildren"], errors="ignore")
    df = df.merge(by_tour[["TOURID", "JourneyWithChildren"]], on="TOURID", how="left")
    u10   = df["PartyNumu10"] > 0
    a1017 = df["PartyNum1017"] > 0
    df["ChildPresence"] = np.select(
        [u10 & a1017, u10, a1017],
        ["Both 0–9 and 10–17", "0–9 only", "10–17 only"],
        default="No children"
    )
    df["ChildPresence_017"]  = (df["ChildPresence"] == "Both 0–9 and 10–17").astype(int)
    df["ChildPresence_09"]   = (df["ChildPresence"] == "0–9 only").astype(int)
    df["ChildPresence_1017"] = (df["ChildPresence"] == "10–17 only").astype(int)
    df = df[df["R_AGE_IMP"] <= 85]
    return df

dT = classify_journey(dT)

output_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "us_jwc_classified.csv")
dT.to_csv(output_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

print(dT.head())
```
